name: al-Sulaka, mother of al-Sulayk
bio: Al-Sulaka is remembered through her son al-Sulayk ibn Umayr, a pre-Islamic poet and raider of Sa'd of Tamim famed for his speed on foot. Al-Tabrizi describes her as a Black enslaved woman, and her son was widely known by her name. He favours the tradition that credits her with the elegy in which a mother tries to discover what befell her absent son.
